template.label: Artwork template
template.description: Choose how playlist artwork is generated. 'Album Grid' uses album covers in a grid layout. 'Artist Mosaic' places the most-played artist large in the centre with others as smaller tiles. 'Artist Grid' shows up to four unique artist images in equal tiles. 'Artist Radio' centers the main artist on a solid background with overlapping circles. 'Artist Banner' overlays the playlist name on a full-bleed artist image (Tidal / Essentials style). 'Album Fan' stacks album covers as framed photo cards, slightly rotated (Apple Music style). 'Album Grid Tilted' renders a grid with white gaps and rotates the whole image ~15° (Apple Music tilted collage style).

skip_provider_playlists.label: Skip provider playlists
skip_provider_playlists.description: When enabled, provider playlists (e.g. from Spotify or Tidal) that already have their own artwork are skipped. Playlists without any artwork still receive a generated collage.
